# Kyra Agent

> Kyra Agent is a Robinhood Chain AI agent platform. Users deploy account-scoped agents from templates, operate them through Telegram, keep private dashboard records, and publish share-safe agent profiles. Wallet authority always stays with the user: every supported onchain action requires explicit confirmation in the user's own connected wallet.

## Product

- [Home](https://kyraagent.xyz/): templates, the action layer, the security model, and FAQ
- [Dashboard](https://kyraagent.xyz/dashboard): private, account-scoped workspace (sign-in required)
- Public agent profiles live at `https://kyraagent.xyz/agents/<agent-slug>`

## Safety Boundary

- Kyra never asks for seed phrases or private keys and never takes custody of funds.
- Telegram and public profiles are read-only; they cannot approve, sign, or submit transactions.
- The official KYRA token contract has not been published yet. Trust only addresses announced on Kyra's official channels.
